4201.meaning1: (gram) at an unspecific time; related to an unstated time

4202.meaning1: not blown off; not removed; not purified

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.

4203.meaning1: without impurities removed; not purged of dross

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ aniddhantakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.

4204.meaning1: not worth treasuring; not worth recording; (comm) not worth keeping in the heart
4204.construction:
na > a + ni + √dhā + na + vant
na + nidhāna + vant
4204.commentary: (MNa) anidhānavati vācan'ti hadayamañjūsāyaṃ nidhetuṃ ayuttaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

examples.text: samphappalāpī hoti akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ

4205.meaning2: no blame; no criticism; not fault-finding

4206.meaning1: not finding fault and offending; not blaming and causing offence; (comm) not blaming and attacking

examples.text: agiddhilobhaṃ nissāya giddhilobho pahātabbo. anindārosaṃ nissāya nindāroso pahātabbo. akkodh'ūpāyāsaṃ nissāya kodh'ūpāyāso pahātabbo. anatimānaṃ nissāya atimāno pahātabbo.

4207.grammar: adj, comp, from na nindārosa, neg
4207.meaning1: who does not find fault and offend; who does not blame and cause offence
4207.construction:
na > a + nindā + rosa + ī
anindārosa + ī

examples.text: ye ca nindārosapaccayā uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, anindārosissa evaṃ'sa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti. anindārosaṃ nissāya nindāroso pahātabbo'ti, iti yan'taṃ vuttaṃ idam'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.

4208.meaning1: blameless; irreproachable; unimpeachable; with clean hands

examples.text: atha antena jahati, sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ, etadaññāya medhāvī, bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca, datvā ca bhutvā ca yath'ānubhāvaṃ, anindito saggam'upeti ṭhānan'ti.
porāṇam'etaṃ atula, n'etaṃ ajjatanām'iva, nindanti tuṇhim'āsīnaṃ, nindanti bahubhāṇinaṃ, mitabhāṇim'pi nindanti, n'atthi loke anindito.

4211.meaning1: not removed; not drained off; not purified

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ dhantaṃ sandhantaṃ niddhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.

4212.meaning1: without impurities removed; not purged of dross

examples.text: taṃ hoti jātarūpaṃ adhantaṃ asandhantaṃ aniddhantaṃ anihitaṃ aninnītakasāvaṃ, na c'eva mudu hoti na ca kammaniyaṃ, na ca pabhassaraṃ pabhaṅgu ca, na ca sammā upeti kammāya.

4215.grammar: adj, from na phala, neg x2
4215.meaning1: not without fruit; not in vain; not without success
4215.commentary: (UDa) anipphalā'ti na nipphalā, sampattasāmaññaphalā eva kālaṅ'katā. tā pana phalāni paṭilabhantiyo sāmāvatiyā

examples.text: sant'ettha, bhikkhave, upāsikāyo sot'āpannā, santi sakadāgāminiyo, santi anāgāminiyo. sabbā tā, bhikkhave, upāsikāyo anipphalā kālaṅ'katā'ti.

4216.meaning1: not tied down; not fastened; not fixed

4217.meaning1: not happened; not arisen; not appeared

4218.meaning1: not leading to putting out the fire; not conducive to Nibbāna
4218.commentary: (MNa) asaṅkhataṃ nibbānaṃ nāma, taṃ paccakkhaṃ kātuṃ na detī'ti anibbānasaṃvattaniko.

examples.text: byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko'ti'pi me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato abbhatthaṃ gacchati.

4219.commentary: (PMa) anibbiddhapubban'ti anamatagge saṃsāre antaṃ pāpetvā anibbiddhapubbaṃ. appadālitapubban'ti tass'eva atthavacanaṃ, antakaraṇen'eva apadālitapubban'ti attho.

examples.text: so satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāvitena cittena anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ lobhakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ dosakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti, anibbiddhapubbaṃ appadālitapubbaṃ mohakkhandhaṃ nibbijjhati padāleti

4221.grammar: prp of na nibbisati, neg, trans (+acc)
4221.meaning1: not understanding; not penetrating; not finding; not getting hold (of)

examples.text: anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, gahakārakaṃ gavesanto, dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ.

4222.commentary: (VIN 2.6.3) animantito nāma ajjatanāya vā svātanāya vā animantito, ghar'ūpacāraṃ okkamante nimanteti, eso animantito nāma.

examples.text: yāni kho pana tāni sekkhasammatāni kulāni, yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekkhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito agilāno khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
animantite nimantitasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa. animantite vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. animantite animantitasaññī, anāpatti.

4225.meaning1: signless; featureless; free of mental images
4225.commentary: (MNa) tattha yo bhikkhu saṅkhāre aniccato pariggahetvā aniccato disvā aniccato vuṭṭhāti, tassa vuṭṭhānagāminivipassanā animittā nāma hoti.

examples.text: kati pan'āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā'ti? dve kho, āvuso, paccayā animittāya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā, sabbanimittānañ'ca amanasikāro, animittāya ca dhātuyā manasikāro.
yass'āsavā parikkhīṇā, āhāre ca anissito, suññato animitto ca, vimokkho yassa gocaro, ākāse va sakuntānaṃ, padaṃ tassa durannayaṃ.

4226.meaning1: without any sign of trouble; without cause for distress; not marked by danger
4226.commentary: (DNa) akhilam'animittam'akaṇṭakan'ti niccoraṃ. corā hi kharasamphass'aṭṭhena khilā, upaddavapaccay'aṭṭhena nimittā, vijjhan'aṭṭhena kaṇṭakā'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: so imaṃ pathaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ akhilam'animittam'akaṇṭakaṃ iddhaṃ phītaṃ khemaṃ sivaṃ nirabbudaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.

4227.commentary: (VINa) animittā'sī'ti nimittarahit'āsi, kuñcikapaṇālimattam'eva tava dakasotan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

4228.meaningLit: discourse on the question about signless

4229.meaning1: liberation of the mind by signless (meditation); emancipation of the heart by (meditation on) featureless
4229.commentary: (ANa) animittācetovimuttī'ti balavavipassanā. dīghabhāṇakā pana arahattaphalasamāpattī'ti vadanti. sā hi rāganimitt'ādīnañ'c'eva rūpanimitt'ādīnañ'ca niccanimitt'ādīnañ'ca abhāvā animittā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: nissaraṇañ'h'etaṃ, āvuso, sabbanimittānaṃ yadidaṃ animittācetovimuttī'ti.

4231.grammar: prp of na nimisati, neg, intrans

examples.text: jāto kho pana, bhikkhave, vipassī kumāro animisanto pekkhati seyyathā'pi devā tāvatiṃsā. animisanto kumāro pekkhatī'ti kho, bhikkhave, vipassissa kumārassa vipassī vipassī tv'eva samaññā udapādi.

4232.meaning1: with no creator; having no designer; with no maker
4232.construction:
na > a + nī + √mā + tar + a
animmātar + a
4232.commentary: (MNa) animmātā'ti animmāpitā. keci animmitabbā'ti padaṃ vadanti, taṃ n'eva pāḷiyaṃ, na aṭṭhakathāyaṃ sandissati.

examples.text: satt'ime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā, te na iñjanti na vipariṇamanti na aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti n'ālaṃ aññam'aññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.

4234.meaning1: not designed (by); not created (by); unfashioned (from); (comm) not created by psychic power

examples.text: satt'ime kāyā akaṭā akaṭavidhā animmitā animmātā vañjhā kūṭaṭṭhā esikaṭṭhāyiṭṭhitā, te na iñjanti na vipariṇamanti na aññam'aññaṃ byābādhenti n'ālaṃ aññam'aññassa sukhāya vā dukkhāya vā sukhadukkhāya vā.

4236.commentary: (VIN 1.3.1) aniyato'ti na niyato, pārājikaṃ vā saṅgh'ādiseso vā pācittiyaṃ vā. (VIN 6.8.5) aniyato'ti yaṃ vuttaṃ, taṃ suṇohi yathātathaṃ, aniyato na niyato, anek'aṃsikataṃ padaṃ, tiṇṇam'aññataraṃ ṭhānaṃ, aniyato'ti pavuccati.

examples.text: ime kho pan'āyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.

nisajjaṃ bhikkhu paṭijānamāno tiṇṇaṃ dhammānaṃ aññatarena kāretabbo pārājikena vā saṅgh'ādisesena vā pācittiyena vā, yena vā sā saddheyyavacasā upāsikā vadeyya, tena so bhikkhu kāretabbo, ayaṃ dhammo aniyato.

4242.meaning2: having not fixed; having not defined

4244.grammar: abs of na niyyādeti, neg, trans (+acc)
4244.construction:
na > a + nī + yāde + tvā
na + niyyādetvā
4244.commentary: (VINa) ovādaṃ aniyyādetvā'ti eso bhaginiyo ovādo'ti avatvā. (VVt) ovādaṃ aniyyādetvā'ti vattanti bhaginiyo aṭṭha garudhammā'ti pucchitvā vattantayyā'ti vutteti etthā'pi so'y'ev'attho.

examples.text: sace vagg'āmh'āyyā'ti bhaṇantaṃ aṭṭha garudhamme bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. ovādaṃ aniyyādetvā aññaṃ dhammaṃ bhaṇati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

4245.grammar: nt, act, from na niyyāti, neg
4245.meaning1: not marching out; not going to war; (comm) returning
4245.meaning2: not marching out; not going to war
4245.commentary: (DNa) raññaṃ niyyānaṃ bhavissatī'ti asukadivase asukanakkhattena asukassa nāma rañño niggamanaṃ bhavissatī'ti evaṃ rājūnaṃ pavāsagamanaṃ byākaroti. esa nayo sabbattha. kevalaṃ pan'ettha aniyyānan'ti vippavutthānaṃ puna āgamanaṃ.

examples.text: te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ, raññaṃ niyyānaṃ bhavissati, raññaṃ aniyyānaṃ bhavissati, abbhantarānaṃ raññaṃ upayānaṃ bhavissati

4246.meaning1: not emancipating; not redemptive; not leading to deliverance
4246.construction:
na > a + nī + √yā + ana + ika
aniyyāna + ika
4246.commentary: (MNa) so pan'esa yasmā maggaphal'atthāya na niyyāti, tasmā aniyyāniko.

examples.text: evarūpe kho, bhikkhave, dhammavinaye yo satthari pataṃ kissa hetu? evañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, hoti yathā taṃ durakkhāte dhammavinaye duppavedite aniyyānike anupasamasaṃvattanike asammāsambuddhappavedite.

4247.grammar: nt, abstr, from na niyyānika, neg
4247.meaning1: fact of not being emancipating; fact of not being redemptive; fact of not leading to deliverance
4247.construction:
na > a + nī + √yā + na + ika + tta
aniyyānika + tta

4248.meaning1: not neglected; not rejected; not omitted; not forgotten
4248.commentary: (MNa) anirākatajjhāno'ti bahi anīhaṭajjhāno, avināsitajjhāno vā, nīharaṇavinās'atthañ'hi idaṃ nirākaraṇaṃ nāma. thambhaṃ niraṃkatvā nivātavuttī'ti-ādīsu c'assa payogo daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo c'assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.

4249.commentary: (MNa) anirākatajjhāno'ti bahi anīhaṭajjhāno, avināsitajjhāno vā, nīharaṇavinās'atthañ'hi idaṃ nirākaraṇaṃ nāma. thambhaṃ niraṃkatvā nivātavuttī'ti-ādīsu c'assa payogo daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu, sabrahmacārīnaṃ piyo ca assaṃ manāpo ca garu ca bhāvanīyo cā'ti, sīlesv'ev'assa paripūrakārī ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno vipassanāya samannāgato brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ.

idh'āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhu paṭisallān'ārāmo hoti paṭisallānarato, ajjhattaṃ cetosamatham'anuyutto anirākatajjhāno, vipassanāya samannāgato, brūhetā suññ'āgārānaṃ. evarūpena kho, āvuso sāriputta, bhikkhunā gosiṅgasālavanaṃ sobheyyā'ti.

4250.grammar: adj, comp, from nirāmagandha, neg x2
4250.meaningLit: not free from the small of raw flesh
4250.commentary: (DNa) etesu yuttā anirāmagandhā'ti etesu cuddasasu kilesesu yuttā pajā nirāmagandhā na hoti, āmagandhā sakuṇapagandhā pūtigandhā'y'evā'ti vadati.

examples.text: kodho mosavajjaṃ nikati ca dubbho, kadariyatā atimāno usūyā, icchā vivicchā paraheṭhanā ca, lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho, etesu yuttā anirāmagandhā, āpāyikā nivutabrahmalokāti.

4251.meaning1: not finished; not stopped; not ceased; not ended
4251.meaning2: not finished; not stopped; not ceased; not ended

examples.text: kiñ'ca tattha iñjitasmiṃ? yadeva tattha vitakkavicārā aniruddhā honti idaṃ tattha iñjitasmiṃ.
mahāsamuddo pathavī, pabbato anilo'pi ca, upamāya na yujjanti, satthu varavimuttiyā.

4254.sanskrit: anila + patha , ākāśa , gagana , nabhas, vyoman, kha

4257.meaning1: not given up; not handed over; not relinquished

4258.meaning1: perceiving as not given up; regarding (something) as not relinquished

4259.grammar: abs of na nissajati, neg, trans (+acc)
4259.meaning1: having not given up; having not handed over; having not relinquished
4259.construction:
na > a + nī + √sajj + itvā
na + nissajjitvā

examples.text: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa. das'āh'ānatikkante atikkantasaññī, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

4260.meaning1: not escaped; not freed; not released (from)

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, brāhmaṇā, bhikkhu lokassa antam'āgamma, lokassa ante viharati. tam'aññe evam'āhaṃsu, ayam'pi lokapariyāpanno, ayam'pi anissaṭo lokamhā'ti. aham'pi hi, brāhmaṇā, evaṃ vadāmi, ayam'pi lokapariyāpanno, ayam'pi anissaṭo lokamhā'ti.
ye vā pana keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā vibhavena bhavassa nissaraṇam'āhaṃsu, sabbe te anissaṭā bhavasmā'ti vadāmi.

4261.meaning1: not released; not relinquished; not handed over (from)
4261.commentary: (VINa) attano hatthato vā yathāṭhitaṭṭhānato vā na nissaṭṭhan'ti anissaṭṭhaṃ

examples.text: adinnaṃ nāmaṃ yaṃ adinnaṃ anissaṭṭhaṃ apariccattaṃ rakkhitaṃ gopitaṃ mamāyitaṃ parapariggahitaṃ. etaṃ adinnaṃ nāma.

4262.meaning1: godless; ruler-less; without an overlord; without power

examples.text: yadatthi saṅgataṃ kiñci, bhavo vā yattha labbhati, sabbaṃ anissaraṃ etaṃ, iti vuttaṃ mah'esinā.
nassa padassa tappurise an ādeso hoti sare pare. na asso anasso, anissaro, anariyo.

4263.commentary: (ANa) anissaravikappī'ti anissaro'va samāno imaṃ detha, imaṃ gaṇhathā'ti issaro viya vikappeti.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? asanthavavissāsī ca hoti, anissaravikappī ca, vissaṭṭh'upasevī ca, upakaṇṇakajappī ca, atiyācanako ca. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kul'ūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.

4264.meaning1: who does not see the escape (from); who does not see the way out (of)

examples.text: sukhaṃ vedayamānassa, vedanaṃ appajānato, so rāg'ānusayo hoti, anissaraṇadassino.

4265.meaning1: not knowing the escape; not understanding the remedy

examples.text: tesaṃ gihī pasann'ākāraṃ karonti. te taṃ lābhaṃ gadhitā mucchitā ajjhopannā anādīnavadassāvino anissaraṇapaññā paribhuñjanti.

4266.commentary: (ANa) anissaravikappī'ti anissaro'va samāno imaṃ detha, imaṃ gaṇhathā'ti issaro viya vikappeti. (ANt) anissaro hutvā vikappeti saṃvidahati sīlenā'ti anissaravikappī.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? asanthavavissāsī ca hoti, anissaravikappī ca, vissaṭṭh'upasevī ca, upakaṇṇakajappī ca, atiyācanako ca. imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato kul'ūpako bhikkhu kulesu appiyo ca hoti amanāpo ca agaru ca abhāvanīyo ca.

4267.grammar: fem, abstr, from na issati, neg
4267.meaning1: freedom from jealousy; lack of envy
4267.meaning2: lack of envy, freedom from jealousy

examples.text: katame dve? akkodho ca anupanāho ca… amakkho ca apaḷāso ca… anissā ca amacchariyañ'ca… amāyā ca asāṭheyyañ'ca… hirī ca ottappañ'ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve dhammā.
yā nūn'āhaṃ, bhante, aññaṃ jātiṃ anissāmanikā ahosiṃ, paralābha-sakkāra-garukāra-mānana-vandana-pūjanāsu na issiṃ na upadussiṃ na issaṃ bandhiṃ, s'āhaṃ, bhante, eta'r'ahi mahesakkhā.

4269.grammar: ger of na nissayati, neg, trans (+acc)
4269.meaning1: not leaning (on); not depending (on); being independent (of)
4269.construction:
na > a + ni + √si > sāy + ya
an + nissāya

examples.text: na diṭṭhiyā na sutiyā na ñāṇena, sīlabbaten'āpi na suddhim'āha, adiṭṭhiyā assutiyā añāṇā, asīlatā abbatā no'pi tena, ete ca nissajja anuggahāya, santo anissāya bhavaṃ na jappe.

4270.grammar: pp of na nissayati, neg (+acc or +abl)
4270.synonym: asāratta, asita, nirāyattavuttī, pavivitta, vippayutta, vivitta, visaññutta, visaṃyutta
4270.commentary: (ITIa) anissitenā'ti taṇhādiṭṭhinissayavasena kañci dhammaṃ anissitena, rāgabandhanādīhi vā abandhena.

examples.text: atthi kāyo'ti vā pan'assa sati paccupaṭṭhitā hoti yāva'd'eva ñāṇamattāya paṭissatimattāya anissito ca viharati na ca kiñci loke upādiyati
duve imā cakkhumatā pakāsitā, nibbānadhātū anissitena tādinā, ekā hi dhātu idha diṭṭhadhammikā, saupādisesā bhavanettisaṅkhayā, anupādisesā pana samparāyikā, yamhi nirujjhanti bhavāni sabbaso.

4271.commentary: (ANa) anissitāyā'ti vaṭṭaṃ anissitāya. vivaṭṭanissitam'eva katvā katheti, vaṭṭanissitaṃ katvā na kathetī'ti ayam'ettha adhippāyo.

examples.text: āyasmā visākho pañcālaputto upaṭṭhānasālāyaṃ bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti… poriyā vācāya vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā pariyāpannāya anissitāya

4273.grammar: fem, abstr, from na issukī, neg
4273.meaning1: fact of not being jealous; not being envious
4273.construction:
na > an + √iss + ā + ukī + tā
anissukī + tā

examples.text: makkhissa purisapuggalassa amakkho hoti parikkamanāya, paḷāsissa purisapuggalassa apaḷāso hoti parikkamanāya, issukissa purisapuggalassa anissukitā hoti parikkamanāya

4274.meaning1: who is not jealous; who is not envious
4274.construction:
na > an + √iss + ā + ukī
anissā + ukī

4288.commentary: (VIN 2.5.5.10) anīkaṃ nāma hatth'ānīkaṃ, ass'ānīkaṃ, rath'ānīkaṃ, patt'ānīkaṃ. tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatth'ānīkaṃ, tayo assā pacchimaṃ ass'ānīkaṃ, tayo rathā pacchimaṃ rath'ānīkaṃ, cattāro purisā sarahatthā pattī pacchimaṃ patt'ānīkaṃ

examples.text: dirattatirattaṃ ce bhikkhu senāya vasamāno uyyodhikaṃ vā bal'aggaṃ vā senābyūhaṃ vā anīkadassanaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
akkosaṃ vadhabandhañ'ca, aduṭṭho yo titikkhati, khantībalaṃ bala-anīkaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

4291.commentary: (DNa) anīkadassana nti, tayo hatthī pacchimaṃ hatthānīkan'ti-ādinā (pāci. 324) nayena vuttassa anīkassa dassanaṃ. (KVa) anīkassa dassanaṃ anīkadassanaṃ. anīkaṃ nāma dvādasapuriso hatthī, tipuriso asso, catuppuriso ratho'tiiminā (pāci. 314) lakkhaṇena tayo hatthī pacchimakaṃ hatth'ānīkaṃ, assānīka-rathānīkesu'pi es'eva nayo. cattāro pana āvudhahatthā purisā pacchimakaṃ patt'ānīkaṃ.

examples.text: dirattatirattaṃ ce bhikkhu senāya vasamāno uyyodhikaṃ vā bal'aggaṃ vā senābyūhaṃ vā anīkadassanaṃ vā gaccheyya, pācittiyaṃ.
